faq.a: 20+ only. Bring a valid ID or passport.
Grown & sexy. Smart casual, vintage tees, clean sneakers, throwback fits. No beach wear, flip-flops, tank tops on the boys, sports shorts or gym wear.
Timeless '90s and '00s R&B, with Hip Hop as the party starter. Nothing after 2010.

faq.q: Can I buy tickets at the door?
faq.a: We cannot guarantee door tickets. Any availability is announced in the days before the event. Buy online to guarantee entry.

faq.q: How do I book a table or booth?

brands.name: Good Groove
brands.about: Good Groove is a night for people who actually love music. Old school funk, disco, hip hop and R&B, played by DJs who know the difference between a hit and a groove. No posing, no gimmicks. Just good records, good people and a room that moves. The perfect start to your weekend.
brands.schedule: Last Friday monthly · The Red Door
brands.music: Old school funk · Disco · Hip hop · R&B

faq.a: The Red Door, 89/8 Sukhumvit Soi 24, 3rd Floor, Staybridge Suites, Bangkok.
Doors open at 10pm. Come early, the warm-up is half the fun.
Smart casual and comfortable. Dress like you want to dance, not like you want to be photographed.

faq.q: Can I buy at the door?
faq.a: Only if there is space left on the night, at ฿750. Capacity is limited, so booking ahead is encouraged.
20+ with ID.
All sales are final. If an event is cancelled, your ticket moves to the next event or a suitable new date.

faq.q: Do table and lounge upgrades include entry?
faq.a: No. Entry tickets are not included with any upgrade and must be bought separately.

brands.tagline: Eat • Sing • Dance. Bangkok's monthly old school R&B day party.
